options.label: Ask Bob to generate the watsonx.ai API boilerplate and explain the auth
options.bobResponse:
watsonx.ai API boilerplate generated.

Auth: IAM token-based. Exchange your API key once per session:
```python
import requests

IAM_URL = "https://iam.cloud.ibm.com/identity/token"
token_resp = requests.post(IAM_URL, data={
  "apikey": API_KEY, "grant_type": "urn:ibm:params:oauth:grant-type:apikey"
})
token = token_resp.json()["access_token"]
```

Generation call:
```python
WX_URL = "https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/text/generation"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
payload = {"model_id": "ibm/granite-13b-instruct-v2",
           "input": "Explain watsonx in one sentence.",
           "parameters": {"max_new_tokens": 100}}
resp = requests.post(WX_URL, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(resp.json()["results"][0]["generated_text"])
```

Ready to test. Run this and check the output.
options.outcome: Boilerplate runs. Auth works. First API response received. ✓


Panggilan generasi:
```python
WX_URL = "https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/text/generation"
```

id.problem: API sudah berjalan tapi test melempar `KeyError: results`. Response schema tidak sesuai dengan yang ada di dokumentasi. Perlu debug dan perbaiki sebelum demo VP.

options.label: Ask Bob to debug the error and suggest the fix
options.bobResponse:
Debug complete.

`KeyError: results` — the response key changed in API v2. The actual structure is:
```json
{
  "model_id": "ibm/granite-13b-instruct-v2",
  "created_at": "...",
  "results": [{ "generated_text": "..." }]
}
```

Your code accesses `resp.json()["results"]` correctly, but the error fires when the request itself fails (non-200). Add a guard:
```python
if resp.status_code != 200:
    raise RuntimeError(f"API error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")
print(resp.json()["results"][0]["generated_text"])
```

Root cause: missing `project_id` parameter in payload. Add `"project_id": PROJECT_ID` to the payload dict.
options.bobFollowUp: Apply the fix and re-run the tests

`KeyError: results` — kunci respons berubah di API v2. Struktur sebenarnya:
```json
{
  "model_id": "ibm/granite-13b-instruct-v2",
  "created_at": "...",
  "results": [{ "generated_text": "..." }]
}
```

Kode Anda mengakses `resp.json()["results"]` dengan benar, tapi error muncul saat request gagal (non-200). Tambahkan guard:
```python
if resp.status_code != 200:
    raise RuntimeError(f"API error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")
print(resp.json()["results"][0]["generated_text"])
```

Akar masalah: parameter `project_id` yang hilang di payload. Tambahkan `"project_id": PROJECT_ID` ke dict payload.
